title: Head of Product
jd_excerpt:
At CENTRO, we build and operate digital products with a global team spanning Canada, Cyprus, the US, Ukraine, Poland, Georgia, and beyond. We bring more than 15 years of experience in product development, design, and online marketing.
 We’re looking for a Hands-on Product Leader who loves getting deep into a product: understanding how customers behave, finding what holds them back, and turning those insights into improvements that matter. You’ll own the direction of an established digital marketplace where content creators connect with their audiences and monetize their work.
 This is a high-volume platform with payments and payouts at its core. Growth matters, and so do trust, safety, compliance, and a reliable customer experience. You’ll have the autonomy to make difficult trade-offs and the accountability to see your decisions through.
 What you’ll own
 Product direction: Set priorities and build a roadmap tied to customer needs and business outcomes. Decide what to pursue, what to fix, and what to leave for later.
 B2C growth: Find opportunities to improve conversion, retention, monetization, and the experience for creators and their audiences. Define how you’ll measure success, then learn from the results.
 Product delivery: Work closely with Engineering to turn priorities into clear requirements and workable plans. Surface dependencies and blockers early, and help the team deliver reliably.
 Platform health: Give critical product issues the attention they need, balancing new opportunities with stability, trust, safety, and compliance.
 Cross-functional decisions: Bring together Engineering, Commercial, Growth, BI, and other partners. Challenge assumptions, resolve competing priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to leadership.
 Identify where AI could improve the customer experience, product performance, or internal workflows. Evaluate opportunities with the AI and BI teams, test promising ideas, and measure their impact.
 What you bring
 7+ years in product management, with substantial experience building or growing B2C digital products.
 Ownership of an established, revenue-generating product, including its strategy, priorities, delivery, and performance.
 Evidence of improving outcomes such as conversion, retention, customer experience, or monetization.
 Strong product judgment: you use customer insight and data, understand the commercial impact of decisions, and can make a call when the evidence is incomplete.
 The ability to work closely with Engineering on technically complex products and navigate operational or regulatory constraints.
 A practical deep understanding of AI and how it can be applied to digital products and product management. You can assess its potential, limitations, and risks.
 Experience leading product managers or guiding cross-functional product teams.
 Marketplace, subscription, or high-volume transactional experience would be especially relevant. 
 What success looks like
 In your first 90 days, you’ll progressively taking over day-to-day product leadership and execution.
 Clear ownership of product priorities, with a roadmap aligned to the business.
 Better visibility, accountability, and predictability across product and engineering execution.
 Progress on stabilizing critical product, commercial, and compliance issues.
 A reliable product performance baseline and reporting framework.
 Measurable improvements on the highest-priority initiatives.
 Why join CENTRO?
 You’ll take ownership of a live product with meaningful scale and room to improve. You’ll work with international teams, have the freedom to challenge ideas, and see the effect of your decisions on customers and the business.
 We offer competitive compensation, remote flexibility, paid time off, support for professional development, and opportunities to connect with colleagues at team and industry events.
 If you care deeply about B2C products and want the responsibility to make one better, we’d like to meet you.
 Originally posted on Himalayas
